item.title: 0.4.1-beta
item.description:
## Fixes
- **Printing works.** File ▸ Print Message… opens the print sheet instead of saying the app does not support printing. - **`mailto:` links open only the composer.** Before, each link also opened a second main window that took over the mailbox and left triage disabled until relaunch. - **Horizontal split.** Both panes span the full width and open half and half. The split keeps its proportion when the window resizes, and the position you drag it to is remembered. - **Main window position and size are restored** across launches. - **Names.** The app menu reads "Nextcloud Mail", the list title shows translated folder names ("Inbox", not "INBOX"), and the ⋯ menu says "Mark as unread/read/important/unimportant".
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hamza221/nc-mac-mail/compare/v0.4.0-beta...v0.4.1-beta

item.title: 0.4.0-beta
item.description:
## What's new
- **In-app updates.** The app checks for updates once a day; App ▸ Check for Updates… checks right away. If an update arrives while you are busy, the sidebar shows a line instead of a window taking focus. - **Update channels.** Settings ▸ General ▸ Updates chooses **Stable** or **Beta** (which also gets pre-releases). Beta builds start on Beta. - **Signed and notarized.** This is the first release signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so it opens without right-click → Open.
## Fixes
- Folders could disappear from under their accounts in the sidebar after switching the layout mode (#7).
## Upgrading
0.3.0-beta and earlier have no updater: replace the app by hand once. Updates after this one install themselves.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hamza221/nc-mac-mail/compare/v0.3.0-beta...v0.4.0-beta
